name: Gorse

vendor.hq: UNKNOWN (community project; lead historically China-based, Docker images under zhenghaoz/* on Docker Hub)
vendor.scale: ~9.7k GitHub stars, ~900 forks as of 2026-06; 52 releases, latest v0.5.10 (2026-06-19). Apache-2.0.

ports: NOTE: 9094/9095 from the seed are NOT Gorse ports in any version verified

verification_primitive.probe: GET http://TARGET:8088/api/dashboard/stats with no headers (read-only). Fallback fingerprint: GET http://TARGET:8088/ and check <title>Gorse Dashboard</title>; liveness: GET /api/health/ready.
verification_primitive.success_signal: HTTP 200 + JSON body containing numeric fields for user/item/feedback counts (e.g. num_users/num_items/positive feedback). A 401 'unauthorized' JSON means an api_key/admin_api_key IS set (surface open, access not exercised). 200 = auth is off and the data layer is readable.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: Confirms the recommender's full data graph (user IDs, item catalog, behavioral feedback) is readable without credentials; /api/dump escalates to a complete database export and /api/purge to destructive write.

endpoints.returns: Gorse Dashboard SPA. With default empty creds, checkLogin() returns true unconditionally - full UI, no login.
Cluster-wide counts: users, items, feedback, valid positive/negative feedback. Unauth when api_key empty.
List of user IDs in the system (paged). Direct enumeration of the host app's user base.
Per-user record + labels; with /feedback/ subpath, that user's full interaction history.
Live running config (config/schema variant too) - reveals backend DSNs structure, recommenders, OIDC/openai settings presence.
Node inventory: node type, name, internal IP, API+metrics addresses - maps the rest of the deployment.
Item catalog entries; /items paged. Item IDs, labels, comments, timestamps.
Personalized recommendation list for any user-id - behavioral inference on individuals.
Insert/overwrite feedback, bulk import users/items, full DB dump/restore/purge. WRITE + EXFIL surface when unauth.
Prometheus metrics, Swagger API spec, and Go pprof profiling endpoints - all mounted on the container, useful for fingerprint + version + intel.
Liveness/readiness; explicitly exempt from the API-key filter (HasPrefix "/api/health/"). Reliable unauth liveness probe even when api_key IS set.
